svg.title: Every handoff is an interpretation
svg.desc: The traditional lifecycle moves from business need to requirements, user stories, technical design, code and tests, with people interpreting each step. A simple requirement to update a delivery address hides many questions about the domain, validation, order lifecycle, integrations, privacy and existing behaviour.

text.font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
